title: Reality Measurement Allocation — Held-Out Sequential Assay Routing
question: When sequence-derived prediction is not reliable enough to veto candidates directly, can it still reduce scarce wet-lab measurements by routing each candidate to the most informative failure assay first while preserving exact final dispositions?

cost_model.reason: No frozen source-backed monetary or time cost schedule is available.

policies.exhaustive: Reveal all three assays for every candidate.
policies.best_static: Choose the best of all 6 fixed assay orders using outer-training truth only; on held-out candidates stop at first observed failure.
policies.history_adaptive: At each state choose the remaining assay with highest smoothed outer-training conditional failure rate given the already observed PASS subset.
policies.sequence_adaptive: At each state choose the remaining assay with highest held-out predicted failure probability from sequence descriptors plus already observed clean assay values. Models are trained only on outer-training candidates that could reach that state.
policies.oracle: For failing candidates reveal one known-failing assay; for clean candidates reveal all three. Unattainable upper bound.

authority_boundary.VETO: requires an actually revealed assay value beyond its frozen failure threshold
authority_boundary.RETAIN: requires all three actually revealed assay values within frozen thresholds

outer_evaluation.sequence_model: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, L2, max_iter=5000) on fixed sequence descriptors plus observed-pass assay values
outer_evaluation.fallback: Laplace-smoothed conditional failure frequency when a conditional sequence model lacks both classes

prior_result.RGV-PILOT: NO_PILOT_VETO_SIGNAL on 197 evaluable GDPa1 antibodies (143 clean / 54 bad). Direct learned veto authority is therefore closed under its frozen stop rule.

claim_boundary.sequence: Held-out simulation evidence that sequence-conditioned routing reduced assay reveals relative to the best fixed order while all final VETO/RETAIN decisions remained measurement-backed.
claim_boundary.history: Held-out simulation evidence that adaptive routing helped, but sequence information did not earn a material routing increment over simple conditional assay-history statistics.
forbidden: real-dollar laboratory savings without a source-backed assay cost schedule

stop_rule: If NO_MEASUREMENT_ROUTING_SIGNAL, close the three-assay routing hypothesis on this substrate. Do not rescue it by changing thresholds, source cohort, fold assignment, savings bars, or cost weights after observing the result.
